meaning: person who works land / keeps livestock

english.meaning: person who works land / keeps livestock
english.note: This is the all-purpose term for a person who farms or keeps livestock.

exampleSentences.english: My dad is a farmer and goes to the fields early every day.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我阿爸係農夫，平日朝早就落田。
